Their full finite-field splitting determining an entire cubic-surface Frobenius Weyl class is a natural exact arithmetic reconstruction theorem. The 40-point scheme is smaller than the known 72-sixer detecting scheme; unlike the 27 lines alone, its zeta spectrum distinguishes all 25 Weyl types. The nontrivial degree-nine cutoff and one rational-triplet supplementary observation give meaningful sharp observation principles. This is a complete finite classification with concrete arithmetic consequences rather than a textbook character-table restatement.
